title: Wiem i Powiem — whistleblowing application
summary: A whistleblowing reporting application connected to the system used to review and handle reports.

blocks.text:
With Wiem i Powiem, whistleblowers can report a breach in three ways: online, by phone or by post. The application handles the online reporting channel.

A report submitted through the form goes directly into the system the company uses every day. Receiving a report and working on it therefore take place in a single tool.
